text: Bronze streams continuously, but Gold has only ever run by hand. This video schedules it properly, and gives support a second, faster way to check a package's status.

A Databricks Workflow runs Silver then Gold every fifteen minutes, with the dependency explicit and an alert on failure. A Fabric Eventstream reads that same Kafka topic independently, through its own consumer group, into an Eventhouse table.
Gold only starts once Silver actually finishes -- never against a half-written table -- and a stuck run gets killed and alerted on rather than piling up behind the next schedule.
The KQL function resolves status with arg_max on the event's own timestamp -- the idiomatic way, and a detail that matters far more than it looks like it should.
Two independent views of the same data, both live. Next: a support ticket that puts that second view to immediate use.
